0022600220.text: The Bulls (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak and 14th in the East) host the San Antonio Spurs (8-2, on an eight-game winning streak and 1st in the Southwest) in Chicago's 10th game of the season. Chicago is without Norman Powell (out with shoulder inflammation; 19.3 points and 28.8 minutes per game this season) and Zach Collins (out with illness), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bulls lost the 2025-26 season series 0-2, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30, 2026.
